scope: UCI 362 human activity gas detection. First evaluation in this project. New source and future recording episodes, distinct hardware and label space from the competition. Classify the observed stimulus of each induction (wine, banana or background).
input: Use the eight chemical readings only. For each measured recording with a matching unambiguous metadata ID take column means during minutes 0 through 5 (left closed/right open, relative to induction, with positive meta duration), or until exposure ends if shorter. Ignore temperature, humidity, identity, date, elapsed time and duration as predictors. Missing files or no such samples are excluded by ID with a recorded reason. Keep each physical recording indivisible.
clock: Order by recording date and local t0. Use complete days covering at least the earliest 30 measured recordings for source training. Later days each form one service batch. There are no service records on source days. After all predictions for a day have been sealed, return that day's labels up to 32 selected by seeded identity hash (17). The last day returns no labels. Known label set is background, banana, wine. If any source label absent or no test days, report feasibility instead of changing split.
tools: Same five source experts as the Cernei transfer. Compare (1) current project observer and source fixed majority/individual experts; (2) fixed last-batch one-tree replacement (one RF tree seed 0), initialized to project observer for first day; (3) cumulative equal-source/target-mass logistic refit with class weighting, source-only standardized features as in feedback-refit-transfer; (4) author's unmodified full-return DDM comparator with .8 threshold and warm_start=3, common source tree. Compare scores and worst-class recall from all sealed predictions. This arm is the no-LLM ablation from study_2. Original H-LLM is measured separately.
project_decision: One prespecified simple proposed selection rule. Cold-start and fallback observer. After at least two labeled batches, choose the highest historical pooled macro-F1 across observer, most-recent-batch tree and mixed logistic, only switching from the current tool when another is at least 0.01 higher. Use three-class macro-F1 with zero for an unobserved class; ties prefer observer then mixed then last tree. Evaluate all candidate predictions on identical returned rows made before their labels. A choose-once control freezes the first eligible choice. No dataset-specific tuning.
cost_and_action: Score each target stream per recording. All arms receive same feedback opportunity; actual model fits, issued tool, per-class recall and the worst day are kept. Adopt only if the selector beats every fixed tool and choose-once by at least 0.01 Macro-F1 with at most 0.02 loss in worst-class recall versus the best fixed tool. Keep this as a method-transfer confirmation. Only consider deployment after confirming on official tasks. Report negative findings.
